key_grammar: <cc>|<io>|C<c_z>|H<c_hidden>|N<=<tokens>|<dir>   io: bf16 (bf16 pair in / out) | fp32 (fp32 pair in / out; TF32 trunks read the same cells); dir: out | in
cell_grammar: k1: {BM, BN, num_warps, num_stages, tma}  k3: {BM, BN, num_warps, num_stages}  ck / chk: channel chunk of c_z / c_hidden (null = the width itself when a power of two <= 256, else 128)  form: NT | TN (the contraction form measured faster at the cell's padded extent; incoming takes it on transposed planes)  k1_ptr (cc 9.0 cells): the fastest POINTER-load K1 tile of the same sweep, served instead of k1 when the triton at hand has no tensor-descriptor API (kernels.has_descriptor_api() False, e.g. triton 3.3) -- same kernel statements after the loads

evidence.protocol: K1 grid BM {64,128} x BN {32,64,128} x warps {4,8} x stages ({2,3} descriptor | {1,2} pointer) x both plane orientations; K3 grid BM {32,64,128} x BN {32,64,128} x warps {4,8} x stages {1,2}; bmm NT | TN; 3 warm-up + 10 timed launches per point (CUDA events, median ms); c 256 also swept with 128-channel chunks; points that do not compile or launch (shared-memory limits) are recorded in the sweep record and never tabled; form NT kept unless TN is faster by more than 2 %
evidence.race_ms: per cell: served ms of this package (mine; mine:x32 = lever x32) and of the kernels.trimul provider rows at the cell's size on the same device in the same process (2 ABBA rounds x 10 timed calls, medians), keyed by the trunk precision word (bf16 | fp32 | tf32); relrms vs an fp64 statement of the op where N <= 800
evidence.race_ms_pointer_k1: cc 9.0 cells only: the same races on H100 under torch 2.7.1 / triton 3.3.1 stacks (no tensor-descriptor API: the cell's k1_ptr tile serves; K3 / bmm unchanged), c 384 and c 128
